sections.text: Characteristic of the impedance measuring function in the line protection REL100

This procedure 
details the steps required to completely check the proper operation and 
calibration of the REL 100 relay. It is recommended this procedures be carried out 
on an annually bases.

The first 
preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activities required 
prior to testing. Some of these steps could be performed days before the actual 
test. The second section Preparation for testing describes the steps to set up 
the equipment for performing the actual tests. The third section is the actual 
test.

A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required

Personal protective equipment must be 
 used as safety Helmet, and safety shoes... etc.

sections.text:
Return Protection Scheme and Associated Equipment 
to Service

items: Return the rely REL100 to service by with drawing the test plug handle from the relay.
Make sure C.T secondary are opened.
Return the relay to service by restoring supply from voltage transformer (V.T) (M.C.B) is closed.
Place the associated Barker Failure ( B.F) protection scheme back in service.
Restore the previously blocked disturbance alarms and fault recorder associated with this protection.
Return the relay Power Line Carries (PLC) links to their normal position.
Turn ON the associated auto - reclos scheme.
Turn ON the power supply DC to relay REL100.
Take crossed reading of all AC currents and voltages supplied to the relay REL100 and compare them to those for normal load conditions.
Check that these readings agree with station Meters , MVAR , Power Factor ,Amperes , voltages.
Place a copy of the test results in the field maintenance file and Test sheet
